## Approved plan task B4

- **Functional scope/files:** affected tests, any approved E2E suite, and removal of the old BO tuple/direct-Incoming paths after repository reference checks. Delete temporary compatibility code only once every caller is migrated and equivalent regression coverage is established.
- **Tests before removal:** assert all supported BO flows use the shared ingress and response contracts. Implement consolidated E2E after B3; preserve existing scenario assertions. Include two sessions and a stale-response/new-chat journey.
- **Branches:** full A0 parity matrix, unavailable services, failure fallback, empty and restored histories, session isolation.
- **Mocking:** same isolated external fixtures; no production test branches.
- **Documentation:** mark BO contract implemented and retire legacy examples; record passing validation and the exact compatibility removals.
- **Action reuse:** not applicable to coverage/cleanup; no new business operations.
- **Done:** BO migration reviewed, its isolated suites and `mix q` pass, and no production ChatLive dependency on legacy tuples remains. Widget implementation is now unblocked. Follow full workflow gates if landing this phase as its own PR.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.7 (B3).
Blocks zaq-pkd.9 (C1).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.
Track E2E scenarios here during A/B implementation; defer new/substantially rewritten journey authoring until B3 human approval. Never depend on parent closure.

comments.text: B4 implemented and validated 2026-10-04. Removed flat WebBridge.to_internal BO compatibility, metadata-selected legacy send/upsert delivery, and standalone status_update/pipeline_result ChatLive handlers. Characterization scenarios now deliver normalized Response envelopes. Fixed late-result leakage by clearing current_request_id on new chat, successful restoration and active-conversation deletion. Added consolidated E2E for send/resume/message info, two-session isolation and delayed completion after new chat; delay confined to test-only LLM fixture, completion observed through persisted history. Updated channels service contracts. Migrated default bridge fixture to trusted delivery and replaced flaky VM-wide atom-count property with generated-input interning assertions. Validation: mix q passed; 368 tests + 1 property passed; existing/new E2E 18/18 passed on Firefox/WebKit/Chromium; git diff --check passed; production legacy handler/caller audit clear. Action reuse: local-only UI correlation reset; no new business operations/Actions, existing shared ingress and Engine operations retained. Changes uncommitted pending Git authorization. Final PR coverage/precommit gate remains for V1; no final approval requested at this issue boundary.

B4 committed with explicit user authorization as c746f2a5 (refactor(bo): retire legacy WebBridge transport). Initial commit hook failed with ExDNA Task.Supervised.stream(5000) timeout; retry succeeded with hooks enabled. No push performed.
